docsPromises.promise: A long done_prepare closeout prints explicit progress lines after validation instead of going silent.
If a done_prepare closeout phase hangs, the CLI fails with an attributed phase-timeout diagnostic instead of silently running forever.
The focused smoke passes and documents that B-783c activity logging is a baseline, not a substitute for real-time done_prepare progress.
